scope: Nutrient definitions only; public Tzameret source and dictionary, Gen2 registry, and official public documentation. No HPP nutrient values, outputs/ files, Gen1 files, model APIs, or agents used.

inputs.path: data/Tzameret_Israel/Structure of the main foods:nutrients file (מצרכים).xlsx

moh_catalog.evidence: Official catalog specifies nutrient composition per 100 g food. Read through indexed official-page text; direct page fetch returned 403.

moh_dictionary.evidence: Official field dictionary; definitions and units read from the local XLSX. dictionary_row is the one-based Excel row, including the header. Columns A, B, C and F give field, description, unit and notes. Example values in column D are not unit evidence.

gen2_registry.evidence: Target FDC nutrient IDs, names, units and activity conventions; existing registry was not modified.

usda_supporting_dictionary.evidence: Official archive read in memory. Confirms 1100 Iodine, I / UG; 1176 Biotin / UG; 1086 Total sugar alcohols / G; 1232 Cysteine / G; 1157 Carotene / MCG_RE. These are FDC IDs, not legacy nutrient numbers.

usda_sr28.sections: Carbohydrate, Folate, Choline, Vitamins A/D/E/K, Individual Fatty Acids and Table 2 (printed pp. 13-24)
usda_sr28.evidence: Distinguishes activity conventions, folate forms and fatty-acid isomers. Common fatty-acid names do not establish a specific isomer for an undifferentiated entry.

usda_sr_legacy.evidence: Missing nutrient values are not zeros; USDA nutrient values use a 100 g edible-food denominator.

basis.reason: The public description establishes 100 g food, but not a universal edible-portion denominator for every record. The source includes foods with bones or stones, 86 nonblank edible fractions and 140 nonblank refuse fields.
basis.rule: Confirm the selected food's portion and preparation basis before emitting a Gen2 value. Once the source denominator is confirmed as edible food, denominator_factor=1. Do not automatically multiply or divide by edible, psolet or liquid-loss fields. Missing edible does not establish edible=1.

mapping_contract.unit: Normalized source unit. For a non-null usda_nutrient_id, it is also the verified target unit.
mapping_contract.factor: Unit-only multiplier, never an edible-portion adjustment. Null prohibits automatic conversion.
mapping_contract.mapped: Nutrient identity and unit supported; still subject to the common food-basis gate. Target is present in the supplied registry.
mapping_contract.registry_extension_required: Identity, USDA ID and unit supported, but target is absent from the supplied Gen2 registry. Do not import until the registry is explicitly extended.
mapping_contract.needs_review: No active USDA assignment. candidate_ids are review leads, not fallbacks or interchangeable nutrients.
mapping_contract.application: Emit only mapped fields with nonblank values after food-basis confirmation. Preserve source field, Code, makor, unit and evidence. Apply factor once. Do not follow canonical_nutrient_id without a supported conversion.
mapping_contract.missing_values: Keep blanks as null. Preserve explicit source zeros without asserting analytical absence. Do not infer units or identities from value magnitude.
mapping_contract.fatty_acids: Gram values already have the source's 100 g food denominator; they are not percentages of fat. Unqualified C:D fields map only to undifferentiated C:D IDs. Do not add constituent values to their class totals.

vitamin_a_iu.note: Retain IU convention separately; registry canonical ID 1106 does not authorize an IU-to-RAE conversion.

niacin.note: Niacin as named; do not add tryptophan-derived niacin equivalents.

docosahexanoic.note: Dictionary explicitly identifies DHA despite the misspelled column name.

parinaric.note: Preserve the legacy chain-level definition; do not relabel as a specific omega or conjugated isomer.

total_sugars.note: Total sugars, not added sugars; keep sugar alcohols separate.

vitamin_a_re.note: The dictionary explicitly labels this column Vitamin A -RAE. This is a documented header mismatch, not an RE-to-RAE conversion. Scope this decision to this source/dictionary version.

selenium.note: Micrograms confirmed; do not apply a milligram-to-microgram factor.

available_carbohydrate.reason: Dictionary explicitly says available carbohydrate. USDA 1005 is carbohydrate by difference; 1050 specifies summation. Neither method is established here.
available_carbohydrate.required_evidence: Retain a separate source-native nutrient, or obtain the source calculation method and independently justify a derived target. Do not use a direct substitution or automatically add fiber.

carotene_identity.reason: Micrograms are documented, but carotene is not qualified as beta, alpha, a sum or an equivalent. USDA 1157 has MCG_RE units, so its matching generic name is not sufficient.
carotene_identity.required_evidence: MOH definition or nutrient-level donor provenance identifying the carotenoid and mass/activity convention.

vitamin_e_definition.reason: Dictionary states vitamin E in mg without identifying alpha-tocopherol mass versus an activity-equivalent convention.

folate_definition.reason: Generic folate in micrograms does not establish whether values represent total folate, food folate or folic acid across mixed data sources.
folate_definition.required_evidence: Confirm total folate before mapping to 1177. Do not duplicate into 1186, 1187 or 1190. DFE requires the food-folate and folic-acid components, not a universal multiplier on generic folate.

folate_dfe_reserved.reason: Dictionary describes total folate and marks the field empty for future use. All 4624 source rows are blank.
folate_dfe_reserved.required_evidence: An updated definition and populated source are needed before enabling 1190. Do not backfill from folate or turn blanks into zeros.

dpa_isomer.reason: Dictionary gives DPA 22:5 without an omega position; target 1280 explicitly requires n-3.
dpa_isomer.required_evidence: Confirm n-3 through a source definition or the exact donor nutrient; do not infer it from the DPA abbreviation alone.

vitamin_d_definition.reason: Source unit is definitively UG, not IU. The dictionary does not explicitly define the included vitamin D forms.
vitamin_d_definition.required_evidence: Confirm D2+D3, excluding an alternative metabolite/activity convention, before mapping to 1114 with factor 1. Do not interpret the source as 1110 IU or as D2/D3 separately.

cystine_label_conflict.reason: English field says cystine, while the Hebrew dictionary description translates to cysteine. USDA distinguishes cystine 1216 and cysteine 1232; 1232 is absent from this Gen2 registry.
cystine_label_conflict.required_evidence: Resolve the chemical species or reporting convention from MOH or the original nutrient definition before selecting either ID.

vitamin_k_definition.reason: Source unit is UG, but generic vitamin K does not establish phylloquinone (K1). Targets 1183, 1184 and 1185 represent distinct forms.
vitamin_k_definition.required_evidence: Confirm K1 before mapping to 1185. Do not copy the same value to other K forms or construct a total K sum.

choline_definition.reason: Dictionary says choline in mg without defining free versus total choline.
choline_definition.required_evidence: Confirm total choline before mapping to 1180; generic source naming does not establish the included compounds.

edible_portion.reason: Per-100g reporting is confirmed, but edible-food equivalence must be established for the selected item.
edible_portion.required_evidence: A documented portion-basis rule or item-specific evidence, particularly for foods described with bones, stones, shells or refuse. Refer to basis before consuming any mapping.

provenance_rules.rule: makor establishes broad origin, not a nutrient-level definition. A US-origin code alone cannot resolve a needs_review item. Do not claim that label, recipe or calculated values are laboratory measurements.
